text:
ہل ترکے،
تے رن کڑکے،
جاوے ڈاند اکواسا،
اس ہالی دے جیون دا ککوں بھرواسا؟
romanized:
Hal trakké,
Te rann karakké,
Jāvé dand ikvāsā,
Us hālī dé jīvan dā kikū̃ bharvāsā?
literal_en:
If his plough crack,
And his wife scold,
And his bullock go boring to one side,
How can there be any hope of life to such a ploughman?

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
